structured.answer: From what I saw, Clal (כלל) has the lowest fee for the S&P 500 keren hishtalmut: 0.48% from the savings, with Menora right behind at 0.49%. But I'd ask my son or the bank before doing anything.

stuck.why: The list is sorted from most expensive to cheapest, so the answer is at the very bottom and I had to scroll all the way down.
The fee says 'עוד לא דווח' (not reported yet) with a 'חדש' (new) mark, so I didn't know whether it might be cheaper. I left it out.
